analysis: exploratory preranked Reactome enrichment from the age/sex-adjusted representative-record P-MCI-minus-S-MCI statistic
claim_boundary: Exploratory competitive pathway association only; not independent predictive validation, not conversion prediction, and not causal evidence.

mapping.rule: retain only one-to-one local annotation mappings whose symbol exactly matches the MyGene.info human Ensembl-gene lookup snapshot

statistics.ranking: age/sex-adjusted t statistic, P-MCI minus S-MCI; one representative metadata-order record per subject
statistics.test: unweighted running-sum enrichment score plus two-sided asymptotic Mann-Whitney competitive rank-distribution test
